No product-visible partial write set, subordinate authority, output-bearing refusal, recovery deletion, or Charter path/version is permitted.
stop_conditions: Stop before editing any existing function, class, method, module declaration, Cargo file, HCM-2.2 source, or CLI source.
Return blocked if strong native no-follow/durability/serializability cannot be expressed with existing dependencies or if lock order would invert HCM-2.2.
